description: This file defines the internal data structures and class for cycle detection in directed graphs, specifically the GraphCycles class, including methods for managing nodes and edges, cycle detection, and path finding.

classes.name: GraphId
classes.description: Opaque identifier for a graph node, with comparison operators.

classes.name: GraphCycles
classes.description: Class for managing a directed graph with cycle detection, node and edge management, and path finding.

methods.name: InvalidGraphId
methods.description: Returns an invalid GraphId that will never be assigned.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns the GraphId for a given pointer, assigning one if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveNode
methods.description: Removes a node and its edges from the graph.

methods.name: Ptr
methods.description: Returns the pointer associated with a GraphId.

methods.name: InsertEdge
methods.description: Attempts to insert an edge; fails if it would create a cycle.

methods.name: RemoveEdge
methods.description: Removes an edge between two nodes.

methods.name: HasNode
methods.description: Checks if a node exists in the graph.

methods.name: HasEdge
methods.description: Checks if an edge exists between two nodes.

methods.name: IsReachable
methods.description: Checks if one node is reachable from another.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Finds a path between two nodes, returning the sequence of nodes.

methods.name: UpdateStackTrace
methods.description: Updates the stack trace for a node with a given priority.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the recorded stack trace for a node.

methods.name: CheckInvariants
methods.description: Checks internal invariants of the graph; used for testing.
